main_text.p: in subditis exercet, contra hūc terra clamat, & sulci deflent, quia contra eius iniustitiam rudes quidem populi in murmurationis vocibus erumpunt; sed perfecti quiq; prauo eius opere sese in fletibus affligunt, quodq; imperiti clamāt & dolent, hoc probatioris vitæ subiecti deflent & tacent. Hæc cùm itâ se habeant, miror hercle quid Romanistis in mente venerit, q̄p? inter Epistolas Sᵗⁱ Gregorij{k} Priuilegiū tanquā ab illo Sᵗⁱ Medardi Monasterio concessum interserat, in cuius Epilogo hunc in modumk lib.2.Indict.11. inter epist.38. & 39.

[Si quis Regum, Antistitū, Iudicū, vel quarumcunq; sæcularium personarum, huius Apostolicæ authoritatis, & nostræ præceptionis decreta violauerit, aut contradixerit, aut negligenter duxerit, vel fratres inquietauerit, vel conturbauerit, vel aliter ordinauerit: cuiuscunq; dignitatis, vel sublimitatis sit, honore suo priuetur, & vt Catholicæ fidei deprauator, vel Sᵗ. Dei Ecclesiæ destructor, à cōsortio Christianitatis, & Corpore ac Sanguine Domini nostri Iesu Christi sequestretur, & omniū maledictionū anathema-

page.notes: Left strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and was left out. Doubtful: "q̄p" after "venerit," (marked [?]); the superscript "Sti" forms are written as Sᵗⁱ. The text ends mid-word at "anathema-", and the paragraph continues on the next page. No catchword or signature is visible.
